neighbours.label: The noun of a fixed connective or quantity phrase that expects 'of', 'to' or 'that' next (in addition, a variety of, in excess of, the fact that), vs the same idea with a single word
fire: The clinic treats adults. In addition, it runs a program for teenagers.
Birds visit the feeder all winter. It attracts a variety of finches and sparrows.
The bridge was tested carefully. It can carry loads in excess of forty tons.
The plan was approved. Despite the fact that costs rose, work began on time.
The library has many rooms. In addition to books, it lends tools and games.
Kids love the camp. It offers a variety of sports and crafts each week.
The storm was severe. Winds reached speeds in excess of ninety miles an hour.
The team stayed calm. In addition, the captain gave a short speech.
